title: Validation
text: Validation covers four main areas: Person data required columns present (PID, DOB, SEX) optional columns (ENROL_DATE, CENSOR_DATE, CENSOR_TYPE) correctly typed present PID values unique (duplicate persons) Date columns (DOB, ENROL_DATE, CENSOR_DATE) stored 8-digit integers yyyymmdd format Date consistency: DOB ≤ ENROL_DATE ≤ CENSOR_DATE CENSOR_TYPE values allowed set ("missing", "dead", "travelled", "emigrated") least persons active cycle period Vaccination data (skipped vaccination_data = NULL) required columns present (PID, V_DATE, V_SUBTYPE) correctly typed PID values exist person_data V_DATE valid 8-digit integer format V_SUBTYPE codes match defined options file Vaccination dates fall within person’s active period (ENROL_DATE, CENSOR_DATE) Outcome data required columns present (PID, AESI, EVENT_DATE, ENCOUNTER_TYPE) correctly typed PID values exist person_data AESI codes match defined options file EVENT_DATE valid 8-digit integer format Event dates fall within person’s active period Lookback coverage Checks outcome data extends far enough back first vaccination (cycle start, historical aggregation) satisfy lookback requirement. default, least 75% configured lookback period (default: 2 years) must covered. insufficient coverage detected, interactive prompt allows provide custom lookback start date confirm awareness limitation.

title: rapidcycler 1.3
text: aggregate_data() gains new output_format parameter (default "parquet", option "csv") controls format output data files written results folder. Parquet’s columnar dictionary encoding particularly efficient categorical-heavy output tables (repeated age groups, AESI codes, vaccine subtypes, etc.), typically achieving substantially smaller file sizes equivalent CSV. Parquet files readable natively R (arrow::read_parquet()), Python (pyarrow/pandas), SQL engines (DuckDB, BigQuery, Athena, Spark), making well-suited inter-organisational data transfer. "csv" option provided legacy workflows require plain-text output. resuming interrupted aggregation started older version package (change), output_format defaults "csv" suppression step correctly operates already-written CSV files.

title: rapidcycler 1.3
text: Several terms renamed clarity. Old names deprecated exported functions removed future version — currently trigger warning continue work. Output column names renamed immediately backward compatibility layer; update downstream code reads columns. patient_data → person_data: patient_data argument aggregate_data() validate_input_data() now called person_data. return value key generate_synthetic_data() also changed "patient_data" "person_data" (deprecation — update code accesses result$patient_data). V_BRAND → V_SUBTYPE: V_BRAND column vaccination_data now called V_SUBTYPE. Passing data frame V_BRAND validate_input_data() aggregate_data() triggers deprecation warning column renamed automatically. V_BRAND column options$vaccine_info passed check_options_object() similarly renamed -place. Output files previously contained V_BRAND column now contain V_SUBTYPE. V_PLATFORM → V_TYPE: derived vaccine platform column now called V_TYPE. V_PLATFORM column options$vaccine_info renamed -place check_options_object() deprecation warning. Output files previously contained V_PLATFORM now contain V_TYPE. case_ascertainment → clean_window: outcome_info.case_ascertainment key options.txt now outcome_info.clean_window. case_ascertainment column options$outcome_info renamed -place check_options_object() deprecation warning. old new key names accepted reading options file; old names trigger deprecation warning. Output files previously contained CASE_ASCERTAINMENT column now contain CLEAN_WINDOW. Added importFrom declarations stats utils functions. Declared data.table NSE column names via globalVariables() suppress R CMD check NOTEs. Added @examples exported functions. Added GitHub Actions CI workflow R CMD check. Removed empty placeholder files (analyse.R, configure.R, visualise.R). Updated minimum R version >= 3.5.0. Cleaned .Rbuildignore removed stray files.
